note: The harness fork MyGo builds from. Each upstream tag is imported as one commit on refs/harness/upstream/<ref>; 本体's vendored tree is one commit on refs/harness/carry; each bump is one merge whose human resolution lives in resolution/<ref>.patch. scripts/harness-fork/fork.mjs replays this record into a git worktree, and scripts/harness-fork/stage.mjs builds and stages a runtime from it. Every tree hash below is checked during the replay, so a tag whose tarball no longer matches, or a resolution that no longer applies, fails before a build starts. Update this file only together with the resolution patch that produced the new tree.

carry.why: 本体 vendors 23 package directories the upstream tag never had, plus file-level patches inside upstream packages and its own composed packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml. runtime-fork-audit.mjs counts the package half against the base tag; this list is the record a bump is checked against, so a merge that silently drops one fails the stage instead of shipping a Host missing the row it mounts.

bumps.why: Keep 本体's client UI (slot catalog and its occupants) over upstream's rewritten slot API; take upstream's version bump, generated module graph and additive dependency rows; regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml; two adapter seams the build found (EmptyWorkspaceOwnerProps.onPickNoDirectory relaxed to optional, WorkspacePickerInput re-exported) so upstream's new deepseek-chat-import package compiles against 本体's contract.
